Lena (Sales): EpochAI POC update — customer reports very slow time-to-first-token on long prompts, plus sporadic 429s when they ramp. When they switch to our private endpoint it fails with a 403. They asked for a short Dedicated trial price to demo. Can we triage?
Marcus (Solutions): please paste the raw error + any X-Request-ID. also which model variant, typical seq lengths, and client concurrency?
Lena (Sales): error: \"403 egress_denied: policy mismatch\". request id: r-cc77a2. Model pinned: rw-serve-small, seqs ~1100-1800, ~9 clients spiky to ~70 rps.
Ibrahim (SRE): quick checks: 429s look like hitting tenant concurrency or short token-bucket windows. Ask them to inspect response headers: X-Redwood-Quota, X-Redwood-RateLimit-Remaining, X-Redwood-Host. Also confirm SDK batch_window_ms — lots of tiny batches will kill TTFT.
Hana (Eng Oncall): infra metrics found model.kv_cache.hit_rate ~0.11 on the shard for the last 20m; that's low — increases token work and TTFT. Also the 403 smells like their NAT IPs aren't in our egress allowlist for private endpoints.
Yara (Security): to enable Private we need their completed security questionnaire (KMS needs, allowed CIDRs). If they want CMK/HSM that adds time. For POC we can use our managed keys if they accept it. Lena, can you get the SQ?
Marcus (Solutions): mitigation to ask them to try now: set client.batch_window_ms = 30ms, enable connection pooling / session reuse, and reduce concurrency to 4-5 clients while we watch. Also enable shared_prefix_cache in the session if available.
Olive (Customer Success): I'll set up a 30m swarm session, include SRE + Oncall. We can offer a 7-day Dedicated demo (single GPU) pending ops approval; will get pricing from finance/legal.
ops-bot: Alert: runtime v2.15.0 deployed — no batching toggles changed.
Hana (Eng Oncall): collect these before the call: full failing request headers (X-Request-ID), response headers noted above, a tiny repro payload (system + user prompt), and the trace link. Use: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN\" https://console.redwood.dev/api/traces/r-cc77a2`
Ibrahim (SRE): internal commands: `rbxctl metrics query --range 15m \"model.kv_cache.hit_rate{model=\\\"rw-serve-small\\\"}\"` and `rbxctl quota get --tenant epochai`. If hit_rate < 0.2 enable shared cache and warmup; if quota exhausted we can request a temporary bump for the demo.
Lena (Sales): got it — I'll pull the SQ + headers from Epoch and ask them to flip batch_window to 30ms before our 10:30 PST call. I'll post traces here once I have them. Thanks all :pray:
notes: POC swarm prep: TTFT + 429s + VPC 403; advise batching increase, shared_prefix_cache, check KV cache hit rate, request SQ for Private onboarding, Dedicated demo pricing flagged
